name: wild-lanka-go
description: Wild Lanka Go - Wildlife Management System

scripts.dev:backend: node init && cd backend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:both: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: node init && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && cd backend && npm start
